terminal.emulator: clean Bash/Fish shells plus fresh direct PTYs

reference.capture: fresh-shell command resolution and installed release launcher replay

normalization: The home directory, launcher directory, release binary path, PTY path, process identifiers, timestamps, and raw ANSI redraw bytes are omitted or represented by stable markers.
Each shell receives only a synthetic HOME/HERMES_HOME and a PATH containing the user-local launcher directory followed by /usr/bin and /bin; no shell profile or configuration file is read.

The replay checks lowercase hades and capitalized Hades resolution, version/help output, release symlink targets, startup landmarks, raw-mode flags, alternate-screen lifecycle, explicit Ctrl+C exit, and terminal restoration.
The user-local launcher is intentionally not treated as a system command: a shell whose PATH omits ~/.local/bin remains outside this proof.

steps.precondition: Current executable release installed as hades and Hades in ~/.local/bin; clean Bash and Fish shells receive ~/.local/bin on PATH.
Clean Bash/Fish PTYs at 120x40 with isolated synthetic HERMES_HOME and the installed launchers on PATH.

unknowns: A shell without ~/.local/bin on PATH cannot resolve a user-local command; system-wide installation, shell-profile mutation, and other operating systems are outside this task.
Provider credentials, OAuth, network access, model selection, persistence, and streamed responses remain outside the launcher/lifecycle proof.
